lines.zh: 我走起来还是老样子，慢。
lines.en: I still walk the old way: slowly.

lines.zh: 这条土路我走了几十年。
lines.en: I have walked this dirt road for decades.
Roads today are built far too wide.
My staff is old but still fits my hand.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖会在雨天作响。
lines.en: My knees click when it rains.
Step by step, just as before.

lines.zh: 谁把我从旧版本里翻出来了。
lines.en: Who dug me out of an old version?

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，想起以前的村子。
lines.en: Leaves crunch, and I recall old villages.
My robe is patched thrice and holds.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，因为终点早到了。
lines.en: I walk slowly; my ending arrived long ago.

lines.zh: 我翻着旧法术书，页都脆了。
lines.en: I turn brittle pages of my old spellbook.

lines.zh: 以前这段咒语念三遍就够。
lines.en: This spell once needed only three repeats.

lines.zh: 我眯眼看太阳，眼睛不行了。
lines.en: I squint at the sun; my eyes are tired.
Ravagers once came whenever I called.

lines.zh: 我数着剩下的召唤次数。
lines.en: I count how many summons remain.

lines.zh: 现在的年轻人不爱用尖牙。
lines.en: Young folk no longer favor fangs.
I polish the old totem again and again.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就想起那个村子。
lines.en: Wind brings back a certain village.

lines.zh: 我坐着，听自己的骨头响。
lines.en: I sit and listen to my own bones.
One clone of mine has not faded.

lines.zh: 我打了个盹，梦见旧战场。
lines.en: I doze and dream of an old battleground.

lines.zh: 药水瓶上的标签全褪色了。
lines.en: The labels on my vials have all faded.
I rehearse old gestures at the wall.

lines.zh: 安静得像我刚被删掉那会儿。
lines.en: As quiet as when I was deleted.
I put out the lamp to save my power.

lines.zh: 杖头的裂纹又长了半寸。
lines.en: The crack in my staff has grown half an inch.

lines.zh: 你是新来的吧，没见过我。
lines.en: You are new; you have not met me.

lines.zh: 我认得你这身打扮，太新。
lines.en: I know that outfit; it is too new.
Someone once looked at me like that.

lines.zh: 你来晚了，我的时代过了。
lines.en: You are late; my era has passed.

lines.zh: 收起你那种怜悯的眼神。
lines.en: Spare me that pitying look of yours.

lines.zh: 你手上的剑，我见过旧款。
lines.en: I have seen an older version of that sword.

lines.zh: 我把你当成当年的挑战者。
lines.en: I take you for a challenger of old.
You do not fear me. Good.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你还有印象吗。
lines.en: Does this old face ring any bell?
I raise my hand half a beat late.

lines.zh: 你身上有我熟悉的尘土味。
lines.en: You carry a dust I remember.
Come closer; my eyes are poor.
I am old; pain lasts longer now.
Your blade tore an old robe.
I grit my teeth; one is loose.

lines.zh: 血是紫的，跟那时候一样。
lines.en: The blood is purple, as it always was.
I back two steps, leaning on my staff.
A night in bed will mend this wound.
You swing harder than I reckoned.
My charm has cracked.

lines.zh: 疼得我忘了下一句咒语。
lines.en: The pain made me forget the next line.
Do not rush me; I must steady myself.
An old book? Hand it here.

lines.zh: 那种绿宝石，我以前有成箱。
lines.en: I once had chests of those emeralds.

lines.zh: 图腾本来就是我的东西。
lines.en: The totem was mine to begin with.
Any bread? My teeth still work.

lines.zh: 你举着新的药水，我闻不惯。
lines.en: Your new potion smells wrong to me.

lines.zh: 我要那本记着旧咒语的书。
lines.en: I want the book with the old spells.
Do not fob me off with modern coin.

lines.zh: 一件旧袍子，我就跟你走。
lines.en: An old robe, and I will follow.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要回我的时代。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I want my era back.

lines.zh: 东西搁那儿，我自己会拿。
lines.en: Leave it there; I will help myself.
You have bumped an old bag of bones.
I recover slowly; do not blame me.
That leg is an old wound; do not touch.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两件旧家具。
lines.en: We collide like two old pieces of furniture.
I catch the doorframe and stay upright.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，跟你爷爷一样。
lines.en: Strong grip; just like your grandfather.
My staff nearly slipped from my hand.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这把年纪经不起。
lines.en: Step aside; I cannot take a shove.
You are standing on my hem.
I cough twice and call it nothing.

lines.zh: 我的妻子埋在旧版本里。
lines.en: My wife is buried in an old version.
Back then, matches were about lineage.

lines.zh: 现在没人愿意嫁给魔法师。
lines.en: No one weds a magician now.
My clones do not count as company.
Loneliness is an old man's craft.

lines.zh: 我年轻时有封信，没寄出。
lines.en: In youth I wrote a letter I never sent.
Not marriage; my hearing is bad.
I prefer the company of old books.
Growing old as two is a luxury.

lines.zh: 我把戒指收在袍子内袋。
lines.en: I keep a ring in my robe's inner pocket.
I stoop for it at my own pace.
This coin is from an old edition.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的旧法杖头。
lines.en: I pick up my own old staff tip.

lines.zh: 掉下来的书页，得按顺序放。
lines.en: Fallen pages must go back in order.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我留着当纪念。
lines.en: I keep this bone as a memento.

lines.zh: 我拾起你掉的箭，掂了掂。
lines.en: I weigh the arrow you dropped.

lines.zh: 旧的图腾总是自己找回来。
lines.en: The old totem always finds its way back.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I crouch, and my knee cracks.
Do not help; I can still pick things up.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进袖子，忘了在哪。
lines.en: It goes in my sleeve, and I forget where.

lines.zh: 我的清静，被你一脚踩碎。
lines.en: You crushed my quiet underfoot.
No one has challenged me in ages.
I have yielded, but not to you.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在旧符文上。
lines.en: You stand right on an old rune.

lines.zh: 我抬杖，这个动作练了一辈子。
lines.en: I raise my staff; I have practiced a lifetime.
Since you came, do not rush off.
Your blood smells fresh.
I will treat you as my last performance.
Old custom: state your name first.
Then I strike first.
My shadow moves faster than I do.
Today is not your day.
I smell the final act.
Fine. Just the two of us.
You knock your sword on your shield and wake me.
That light by the door is alive.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，来送死的。
lines.en: I know that look; it comes to die.

lines.zh: 你把图腾露出来了，我看见了。
lines.en: You let the totem show; I saw it.
A ravager waits outside the door.
I chant the old spell in a rasp.

lines.zh: 克隆体从我身后走出来。
lines.en: A clone steps out from behind me.

lines.zh: 尖牙还是老样子，先咬脚。
lines.en: The fangs still go for the ankles.
I sip an old potion; it is bitter.
Do not mistake me; I am not that one.

lines.zh: 我的伤口合得比从前慢。
lines.en: My wounds close slower than they used to.

lines.zh: 你砍空的那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the swing that missed.

lines.zh: 我退到柱子后面喘口气。
lines.en: I step behind a pillar to breathe.
No new tricks this time.
The turret is rusted but still fires.
My fireballs fly slower than in my youth.
The more you hurry, the slower I go.
I count to two; you should be running.

lines.zh: 灾厄兽绕到你背后去了。
lines.en: The ravager has circled behind you.
I count to three, and the spell is done.

lines.zh: 你脚下那道圈，是我画的。
lines.en: That circle under your feet is mine.
Walk slowly; I have not risen yet.
My staff tip never leaves you.

lines.zh: 你退一步，火球就近一步。
lines.en: You take a step back; the fireball takes one forward.
My staff lands heavy on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一拳用的还是老招式。
lines.en: This punch is an old technique.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，拧了一下。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and twist.
Fangs bite your boot for me.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，自己差点倒了。
lines.en: I shove you and nearly fall myself.

lines.zh: 我的指节疼，你的脸更疼。
lines.en: My knuckles hurt; your face hurts more.

lines.zh: 以前这一下能打飞三个人。
lines.en: This once sent three men flying.
A decent block, young one.
Too old to chase; I wait where I stand.
I hit slowly, but I hit true.

lines.zh: 这一杖，是替我妻子打的。
lines.en: This blow is for my wife.
Step back and let me breathe.

lines.zh: 我的袍子破了，你赔不起。
lines.en: My robe tore, and you cannot pay.

lines.zh: 别趴下，我的谢幕还没到。
lines.en: Stay on your feet; I am not done.

lines.zh: 换了召唤表，我还是这件旧袍。
lines.en: New summoning table, same old robe.
Dust settles first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 这里跟以前不太一样了。
lines.en: This place is not as I remember.
I sniff the air and frown.
Who tampered with the summon table again?

lines.zh: 我的袍子上还带着旧雪。
lines.en: Old snow still clings to my robe.
The curtain is worn but still opens.
I stand and wait for someone to shout start.
This time I brought a ravager.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸脚下的土，很陌生。
lines.en: I touch the soil; it is unfamiliar.
Three bell tolls, still unchanged.

lines.zh: 我的声音比记忆里沙哑。
lines.en: My voice is hoarser than I recall.

lines.zh: 我把旧图腾举起来看了看。
lines.en: I lift the old totem and inspect it.
I have rehearsed this opening for thirty years.

lines.zh: 旧召唤表把我吐了出来。
lines.en: The old summoning table spits me out.

lines.zh: 我落地时，尘土比我先到。
lines.en: When I land, the dust arrives first.
The moon here is not quite right.
I brush the ash off my robe.

lines.zh: 先看看谁碰过我的台子。
lines.en: First, let me see who touched my altar.

lines.zh: 这具身体是旧的，我记得。
lines.en: This body is an old one; I remember.
This fire burns hotter than in my day.
One fall and my bones creak.
Spells will not form underwater.
The blast leaves my hearing dull.
An arrow lodges in my robe's folds.
Magic these days is far too flashy.
I stopped living on food long ago.
Lightning strikes as if to cue my exit.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有旧版本可回。
lines.en: The void holds no old version to return to.
